messages.content:
Build the UI described below as a single page in an existing Next.js 16 project (App Router, React 19, strict TypeScript).

Stack: Once UI (`@once-ui-system/core` 2.1) is installed and its standard providers are mounted in the root layout; no documentation is available, so work from what you know.

Task: Auth flow — login with password + OTP step in a stacked dialog.

Requirements:
- Write exactly one file, `app/page.tsx`, that default-exports the page. Put "use client" at the top if the page uses state, effects or event handlers.
- Do not create or change any other file. The root layout, global styles and the stack's standard providers already exist. You can read the project's existing files under `project/`.
- Use realistic placeholder content defined inline in the file (no lorem ipsum). Load nothing from the network: no external image, font or API URLs.
- The page must type-check under strict TypeScript, pass `next build`, and render without console errors.
- Make it responsive from phone to desktop, and accessible.
- Reply with the complete file in a single ```tsx code block and nothing else.

messages.content:
Your page failed the typecheck check. Output (truncated to 4,000 characters):

```
app/page.tsx(346,9): error TS2322: Type '{ children: Element; isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void; title: string; description: string; base: true; }' is not assignable to type 'IntrinsicAttributes & Omit<DialogProps, "ref"> & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>'.
  Property 'isOpen' does not exist on type 'IntrinsicAttributes & Omit<DialogProps, "ref"> & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>'. Did you mean 'open'?
app/page.tsx(434,34): error TS2322: Type '{ children: Element[]; gap: "8"; fillWidth: true; mobileDirection: string; }' is not assignable to type 'IntrinsicAttributes & Omit<RowProps, "ref"> & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>'.
  Property 'mobileDirection' does not exist on type 'IntrinsicAttributes & Omit<RowProps, "ref"> & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>'.
```

Fix the problem and reply with the complete corrected `app/page.tsx` in a single ```tsx code block and nothing else.

content.text: Two fixes: `Dialog` uses `open` instead of `isOpen`, and `Row` has no `mobileDirection`, so I use a plain `Flex` with a `s`-breakpoint-aware `direction` prop, falling back to a wrapping `Row`. To stay safe on types, I use `Row` with `wrap` and `fillWidth` children.
